title: Leviathan: an appeals court for wrongful convictions
description: A verifier majority no longer slashes instantly. The accused can convene a larger bonded tie-breaker jury; overturn burns the accusers, uphold finalises the slash, and false conviction finally has a price.

title: Leviathan: the bond can finally actually be posted
description: Bond deposit is no longer library-only. Four run-manager commands plus leviathan-node.sh --bond let a volunteer wallet fund collateral on live devnet before joining a run.

title: Leviathan: I found my own number was wrong
description: Committee economics shows the published break-even bond was about 3.6x too low: verifier pay, not only cheater deterrence, sets the binding floor. For three verifiers: $2.91 becomes $10.55.

title: Leviathan: the cheat hunter needs to eat too
description: Caught cheaters now fund the jury: the forfeited bond is split equally across the verifiers that voted, with on-chain recipient checks and the old single-reporter path left intact.

title: Leviathan: the jury convened on real chain and executed its verdict
description: Live devnet e2e: three bonded clients, two verifiers, quorum two. First vote leaves the target healthy; second ejects and settles slashed = 200 on chain.

title: Leviathan: the jury now convenes on real chain
description: Committee-vote left the lab: SBF stack-safe, upgraded in place on devnet at program 9A1kc8…, existing runs unbroken. Multiparty detection-to-conviction now sits on live network.

title: Leviathan: the verifier is no longer a judge, but a jury member
description: The autonomous daemon no longer slashes alone. It casts a bonded verdict; conviction lands only when enough independent verifiers agree.

title: Leviathan: the cheat-catching machine is live
description: The verifier daemon now detects fraudulent gradients on live Solana devnet and writes the slash on-chain itself. One process, end to end, with a permanent proof transaction.

title: Fusing detection and conviction into one verifier daemon
description: leviathan-verifier-daemon closes the loop in one always-on process: read the coordinator, audit committed work against an honest reference, and slash on fraud with live roster indexing.
